relative_Frobenius_scope: Unweighted Frobenius norm over all listed sample times and fixed candidate-by-receiver entries, not a continuous-time integral. Error-to-peak uses the maximum full reference magnitude on that same submatrix/time grid. Near-zero global reference peak (<=0.002) is indeterminate.
